'''Jedselk''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In the time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he held the title of [[Planetary Governor/Legends|planetary governor]] of [[Sellasas]], during which time the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Siege of Sellasas|besieged]] the planet for several weeks.<ref name="GG10p">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref> His daughter, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Amara Jedselk]], was second-in-command of the planetary [[Imperial Army/Legends|army]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] at the time. Soon after the conflict on Sellasas, Jedselk was promoted to governorship of [[Dolla system/Legends|Dolla]].

During the siege on Sellasas, Jedselk's daughter Amara had saved the life of a [[Srrors'tok]], to whom she gave the adoptive name of [[Tyionsis Cex]]. Governor Jedselk capitalized on Cex's life debt to and personal feelings toward Amara, as well as his hatred for the Rebel Alliance, persuading him to become an Imperial [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] in exchange for his patronage. As governor of Dolla, Jedselk used his influence to smooth over any local unrest caused by Cex's actions while pursuing bounties.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'', Jedselk is described as being "recently promoted to the governorship of Dolla".<ref name="GG10p" /> It was unclear as to whether this referred to a star system named Dolla, or merely a planet by the same name. As a result, it remains unclear as to whether Jedselk was promoted to the position of governor over an entire system, or merely to a planetary governorship of a more prominent planet. When ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' was published, the existence of the Dolla system was verified, though whether a planet named Dolla exists in the system is still open to conjecture.
